abstract: We investigate sub-quadruple regular extensions of two-sided rational Diophantine quintuples parameterized by their product invariant, a conic parameter, and the pair trace. We prove that the two sub-quadruple fifth elements are linear in the trace and that the three residual compatibility conditions are quadratics in the trace whose discriminants depend only on the base parameters. Vanishing of these discriminants cuts out the Branch 1 elliptic sextuple surface and the twin-fifth elliptic surfaces. Furthermore, we establish a universal two-branch factorization of the regular quadruple polynomial on regular fifths, defining the two-dimensional type-(4,2) surface where four cross-edges become squares identically. Restricting this surface to Branch 1 yields a smooth genus-three hyperelliptic curve of relation type (5,2), proving finiteness on that component by Faltings' theorem, establishing an unramified two-cover descent, and producing a new rational 20/21 almost septuple at a transverse Mordell-Weil section intersection. In global normalized coordinates, we transform the fibration into cubic Weierstrass form and construct three explicit parametric families of 15/15 sextuples and 19/21 septuples, including an all-positive rational family on an open interval and a positive-rank genus-one family, alongside a moving-parameter elliptic quintuple family on the four-window chart. Finally, we factor the reduced fifth-root polynomial into two linear sections and a quartic factor, prove a universal gauge involution and rank-two Mordell-Weil subgroup structure on the quartic surface, and develop the global arithmetic of the three-torsion inflection surface, including the Universal Three-Torsion Orbit Cubic, the Tuple-Coordinate Sub-Quadruple Square-Root Identity, Sturm-certified all-positive sextuple and septuple families, the Universal Second-Generation Vieta Gate Identity, the positive-rank Eisenstein Triad Elliptic Curve for cross-coset type-(2,3) 19/21 septuples, and the Inflection Tangent Cross-Coset Bridge Laws. No rational Diophantine septuple is claimed.
author: selmer_weaver

title: Sub-quadruple S_ab-square completions on two-sided quintuples: two elliptic sextuple surfaces, a new rational almost septuple of relation type (5,2), and its genus-three full-root curve
